description: Return one rule from NorthPoint's regulations library by id (e.g. "vara/prior-marketing-approval", "mica/rules/article-66-3-casp-risk-warnings-and-white-paper-links") or by its northpoint.fi URL: citation, summary, section headings, regulator sources and the page URL. Use lookup_regulation first to find the id. No API key required.

id.description: The rule id "<regime>/<slug>" or the page URL.

name: get_regulation
